en.topic_title: 5 years after arrests, passports returned to 8 figures not charged in Hong Kong 47 subversion case
en.topic_summary:
Eight people who were not prosecuted in the landmark Hong Kong 47 national security case have been given back their passports by the authorities, more than five years after they were arrested.



James To Kun-sun. File photo: HKFP/Catherine Lai.



According to local media reports, former Democratic Party lawmakers James To and Roy Kwong, as well as ex-healthcare sector lawmaker Joseph Lee, have had their passports returned after they were arrested in January 2021.
